data.one_liner: A lightweight IoC container for Dart and Flutter that stores instances and factories in a Map.
data.what_it_does: Kiwi lets you register instances, factories, and singletons, resolve them by type or name, and create scoped containers. It has no reflection overhead and supports optional code generation for faster registration.
use_when: You need a simple, fast DI container without reflection.
You prefer a minimal API and want to avoid heavy frameworks.
You want to use scoped containers for isolated parts of your app.
You want optional code generation for boilerplate reduction.
avoid_when: You need advanced dependency graph features like auto-wiring or lifecycle hooks.
You require a full-featured state management solution beyond DI.
You are building a very large application that needs a more mature DI framework.
strengths: Supports scoped containers and provider listing
weaknesses: Limited to basic DI patterns, no lifecycle management
No built-in async support for factories
Documentation is minimal compared to larger frameworks

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: Popular, mature DI container with similar API and extensive community support.
